claim: gethomepage/homepage has ~30,532 stars, 1,953 forks, only 1 open issue, was created 2022-08-24, is not archived, and was last pushed 2026-06-06.

Homepage v1.0.0 shipped 2025-03-14, with the major bump driven by breaking changes: required HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS host validation, upgrade to Next.js 15 (dropping armv7 support), Tailwind v4, and Kubernetes Gateway API support.
quote: We're excited to announce the release of homepage v1.0! ... [BREAKING] Enhancement: require host validation ... [BREAKING] Chore: update to next v15 ... homepage no longer runs on armv7 ... [BREAKING] Chore: upgrade to tailwind v4 ... [BREAKING] Enhancement: support for Kubernetes gateway API
